- `deepseek_full_trace_seed42_v3` cron 回调（训练完成）→ spawn worker 跑 eval → 结果入跨模型对比表 → 向 Director 汇报 plan_004 全部完成

- 不要把 Qwen 的 paired bootstrap CI 和 DeepSeek 的 unpaired bootstrap CI 放在同一张表里——论文审稿人会抓这个不一致

## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

| 分组 | 样本数 | 准确率 |
|---|---|---|

| **需要截断** (>2048) | 1091 | **8.3%** |

Memory\\n\\n## MVP Round 1 结论（已作废）[2026-05-14]\\n\\nRound 1 结果全部无效，原因：\\n1. **VOTA match 泄漏**：assertion output 中 `match=True/False` 直接泄漏 verdict，99.2% accuracy 是 pattern matching 而非理解 trace\\n2. **Label 截断**：full_trace 28.4% 是因为 label 在序列末尾被 tokenizer 截断，模型根本没学到正确标签\\n\\n### 教训\\n- VOTA 输出中任何直接或间接暴露 pass/fail 的字段都是 data leakage——审查 trace format 时需要\\\"如果模型只看这一个字段能否猜到答案\\\"的测试\\n- 训练数据格式化必须保证 label 不被截断——应先预留 label token budget，再分配 trace 空间\\n- `[No trace available - execution failed]` 这类文本也是隐性泄漏（暗示 fail）\\n\\n## MVP v5 + Ablation 结果（当前有效数据）[2026-05-15]\\n\\n### 三条件对比（全部 v5 代码版本，统一 bootstrap CI）\\n- no_trace v5: 75.1% [72.8, 77.5], lift +3.6pp over majority\\n- **full_trace v5: 81.8%** [79.7, 83.9], lift +6.6pp [4.4, 9.0] vs no_trace\\n- **VOTA v5: 99.41%** [98.8, 99.8], lift +24.3pp [21.8, 26.8] vs no_trace (accuracy corrected from 99.16% due to Run 4 adapter overwrite)\\n- **VOTA vs full_trace: +17.7pp** [15.5, 19.8]（所有对比 p < 0.001）\\n\\n### plan_001 ablation: VOTA w/o actual/expected [2026-05-15]\\n- **accuracy 99.4%** [98.9, 99.8] — 去掉 actual/expected 后性能不降反微升（vs VOTA v5 99.2%）\\n- **结论：actual/expected 字段是冗余信息**，VOTA 效果来自 trace 行为模式理解\\n- Claim 1 走 **full positive framing**: \\\"VOTA teaches execution-grounded verdict reasoning\\\"\\n\\n### plan_002 ablation: label-only loss on full_trace [2026-05-15]\\n- **accuracy 86.2%** [84.4, 88.1] — 比标准 full_trace v5 (81.8%) 提升 +4.5pp\\n- **结论：full_trace-VOTA gap 的主因是 information overload（trace 噪声），不是 gradient dilution**\\n  - gradient dilution 贡献: ~4.5pp | information overload 贡献: ~13pp\\n\\n### plan_003a ablation: exception_only [2026-05-15]\\n- **accuracy 99.83%** — pass_F1 0.999, fail_F1 0.997\\n- **[ERROR] 事件是 VOTA verdict 判断的主驱动因素**\\n\\n### plan_003b ablation: loop_only [2026-05-15]\\n- **accuracy 85.6%** [83.5, 87.6]\\n- **结论：loop compression 提供中等贡献，但 exception 是决定性组件**\\n\\n### plan_003c ablation: ae_only [2026-05-15] — Tier 1 diagnostic-moment signal\\n- **accuracy 99.92%** [99.75%, 100%] — 与 exception_only (99.83%) 统计等价\\n- D013 裁定：不是 data leakage\\n- Pairwise bootstrap: vs exception_only p=0.80 ❌ 统计等价\\n\\n### 完整组件重要性层级（D013 确认）[2026-05-15]\\n```\\nae_only         99.92%  Tier 1\\nexception_only  99.83%  Tier 1\\nVOTA w/o ae     99.4%\\nVOTA (full)     99.41%\\nlabel-only      86.2%\\nloop_only       85.6%\\nfull_trace      81.8%\\nno_trace        75.1%\\nmajority        71.5%\\n```\\n\\n### plan_007 calibration analysis v2（P0/P1/P2 修复后）[2026-05-15]\\n| Condition | ECE ↓ | MCE | Brier ↓ |\\n|-----------|-------|-----|---------|\\n| ae_only | 0.0004 | 0.0004 | 0.0008 |\\n| exception_only | 0.0027 | 0.8355 | 0.0013 |\\n| vota | 0.0054 | 0.6225 | 0.0052 |\\n| loop_only | 0.0831 | 0.1834 | 0.1183 |\\n| full_trace | 0.0958 | 0.2491 | 0.1439 |\\n| label_only | 0.1107 | 0.4171 | 0.1201 |\\n| no_trace | 0.1715 | 0.4756 | 0.1972 |\\n- P0: token ID 动态查询（DeepSeek calibration 必须用 v2 代码）\\n- P1: greedy generation 对齐（~3 样本差异）\\n- P2: loop_only MCE null → 0.1834\\n\\n### plan_008 Seed Robustness（Qwen VOTA）✅ [2026-05-15]\\n- **VOTA seed456: 99.08%** [98.5, 99.6] vs seed42: 99.41% → Δ = -0.33pp（CI 内）\\n- fail_recall = 1.000, fail_f1 = 0.984, pass_f1 = 0.994\\n- **VOTA seed robustness 确认**：两个 seed 均 >99%，差异在统计误差内\\n- 进程退出码 129 (SIGHUP) 但评估已完成，结果有效\\n\\n### plan_008 Seed Robustness（Qwen exception_only）✅ [2026-05-15]\\n- **exception_only 99.83% ± 0.00** across seeds 42/123/456\\n- 每 seed 恰好 2/1190 errors\\n- **Irreducible samples 确认**: 3 seeds 错误 100% 重叠——id=901 和 id=905，均来自 HumanEval/95 (`check_dict_case`)，label=pass → pred=fail（false negative）\\n- **根因确认**：Python `all()` 对 generator expression 短路时触发 `GeneratorExit`（`BaseException` 子类，非真正错误），但 tracer 将其标记为 `[ERROR]`。exception_only 模型只看到 7 行 `[ERROR] GeneratorExit`，合理但错误地预测为 fail\\n- 含义：exception_only 已达到**表征层面的理论上限**——这 2 个 error 是 tracer 对 Python 语言特性的误标记，不是模型能力不足\\n- **待验证**：DeepSeek exception_only seed42 (99.83%) 是否也错在 id=901/905（预期相同）\\n- 详见 artifact: `irreducible_error_analysis.md`\\n\\n### plan_004 跨模型验证: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B [2026-05-15]\\n\\n#### 跨模型对比表（3/4 有效 + 1 待重跑）\\n| Condition | Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B | DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B | Δ |\\n|-----------|-------------------|---------------------|---|\\n| no_trace | 75.13% | 73.36% | -1.77pp (不显著) |\\n| full_trace | 81.76% | ❌ v2 killed，待重跑 | — |\\n| VOTA | 99.41% | 84.45% | -14.96pp |\\n| **exception_only** | **99.83%** | **99.33%** | **-0.50pp** |\\n\\n#### DeepSeek full_trace 坍塌 [2026-05-15]\\n- 28.5% accuracy, 100% 预测 fail (pass_recall=0, fail_recall=1)\\n- 同 Qwen v2 full_trace 坍塌模式 — chat template overhead 导致 label 截断\\n- 诊断中：所有条件共享用 Qwen tokenizer overhead=32 格式化的数据，DeepSeek chat template overhead 不同\\n- **不影响其他 3 条件**：no_trace/VOTA/exception_only 输入远短于 full_trace，不触发截断\\n- DeepSeek epoch-level: eval_loss epoch2→3 从 0.090 升至 0.110，train_loss 极低 (0.052) — 模型 overfit 但 generation 坍塌\\n- **v2 重训被 kill**（Loop #6 ops worker 腾 GPU 给 vota_seed456），需在下个 GPU 空闲时重跑\\n\\n#### ⭐ 关键发现：exception signal 跨模型 robust（seed123 是离群值）[2026-05-15]\\n- **DeepSeek exception_only 3-seed 结果**:\\n  - seed42: 99.33% (epoch3), 99.83% (epoch1)\\n  - **seed456: 99.33%** — 与 seed42 完全一致 ✅\\n  - seed123: 91.09% — **离群值**（LoRA 初始化 bad luck）\\n- **2/3 seeds 鲁棒 (99.33%)**，Claim 1 可保留，加 LoRA sensitivity limitation\\n- Qwen 3 seeds: 99.83% ± 0.00（完全稳定）\\n- 跨模型 gap: Qwen 99.83% vs DeepSeek 99.33% = **-0.50pp**（robust）\\n- seed123 离群值特征: train_loss=0.122 偏高, fail_recall=0.705, epoch1 token accuracy=92.55%（从一开始就没学好）\\n- **论文措辞**: exception signal 跨模型有效 (99.33% on DeepSeek)，但 LoRA 初始化偶尔导致收敛到差的局部最优 (1/3 seeds)\\n- Director 决策：exception_only seed robustness 优先于 VOTA seed robustness\\n  - **Framing 备选 B（epoch selection）已排除**，只剩 A（model-dependent ceiling）或 C（LoRA sensitivity on weaker models）\\n\\n#### DeepSeek VOTA 详细数据\\n- **DeepSeek VOTA accuracy: 84.45%** [82.6%, 86.4%]，使用 **epoch 3 final** checkpoint\\n- **DeepSeek no_trace accuracy: 73.36%** [70.8%, 75.7%]，lift +1.85pp over majority (**不显著**, CI [-0.9, +4.6])\\n- **VOTA lift**: DeepSeek +11.09pp [+7.90, +14.37] vs Qwen +24.03pp — 跨模型泛化确认但幅度衰减（pairwise bootstrap p < 0.0001）\\n- **Pass 偏向严重**: VOTA fail recall 仅 45.4%\\n- **DeepSeek exception_only: 99.33%** — within-model lift +25.97pp over no_trace\\n\\n#### ⚠️ Bootstrap 方法一致性待修（非紧急）[2026-05-15]\\n- Qwen 实验用 **paired** bootstrap（有 per-sample predictions）\\n- DeepSeek 当前用 **unpaired** bootstrap（缺 per-sample predictions）→ CI 更宽，是保守估计\\n- **论文同一张表不能混用两种方法**\\n- **待办**: 为 deepseek_vota_seed42 和 deepseek_no_trace_seed42 重跑 `evaluate.py --save_predictions`，再用 paired bootstrap 重算 CI\\n- 当前 unpaired 结果 (+11.09pp [+7.90, +14.37]) 方向正确，paired CI 只会更窄\\n\\n#### eval_loss 与 verdict accuracy 解耦（关键发现）[2026-05-15]\\n- Epoch 1: eval_loss 0.068, accuracy **78.15%**, fail_recall **23.3%**\\n- Epoch 3: eval_loss 0.112, accuracy **84.45%**, fail_recall **45.4%**\\n- eval_loss 上升 (+65%) 但 accuracy 提升 (+6.3pp), fail_recall 大幅提升 (+22.1pp)\\n- **结论**：eval_loss（token-level calibration）与 binary classification accuracy 解耦。eval_loss 不是 verdict task 的可靠 checkpoint selection criterion\\n- **论文价值**: Discussion 中应讨论此现象\\n\\n###
